title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
**Job Title: Performance Marketer**

**Company:**
VK Creatives Software & Marketing Agency

**Location:**
Tarakeswar, West Bengal

**Work Mode:**
In person / Work from Office

**About the Role**

**We are looking for a Performance Marketer to manage digital advertising campaigns for our clients. The candidate should have practical knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO and AI tools, with a focus on generating quality leads, increasing sales and improving campaign performance.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, launch and optimise Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage lead generation, WhatsApp, sales and retargeting campaigns.
* Research audiences, keywords and competitors.
* Monitor advertising budgets, cost per lead, conversions and return on ad spend.
* Test ad creatives, copy, audiences and landing pages.
* Set up and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
* Coordinate with designers and content writers to develop effective advertisements.
* Prepare performance reports with clear insights and improvement plans.
* Use SEO techniques and AI tools to support marketing activities.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Knowledge of SEO and conversion tracking is mandatory.
* Working knowledge of AI tools for marketing is mandatory.
* Ability to analyse data, improve lead quality and optimise campaign costs.
* Strong communication, organisation and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage campaigns for multiple clients.
* Availability to work from our Tarakeswar office.

**How to Apply**

**Apply through Indeed or email your updated CV to**
contact@vkcreativesagency.com. Include campaign examples and results, if available.

**Email Subject:**
Performance Marketer Application – [Your Name]

* **Contact:**
  +91 93323 38530

title: Assistant Professor – Digital Media or/and Marketing Communication
description:
**Assistant Professor – Digital Media or/and Marketing Communication**

**Department:**
Media Science and Journalism

**Programme:**
B.Sc. (Hons.) Digital Media Science and Journalism (AI-Integrated), B.Sc. (Hons.) Media Science and Journalism, and M.Sc. Media Science and Journalism.

The Department of Media Science and Journalism invites applications from qualified and experienced candidates for the position of
**Assistant Professor in Digital Media or/and Marketing Communication**
. The department welcomes applications from academic professionals as well as experienced industry practitioners interested in transitioning into academia and contributing to practice-oriented, industry-relevant education.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Journalism and Mass Communication, Mass Communication, Digital Media, Marketing Communication, Advertising, Public Relations, Digital Marketing or a relevant/allied discipline, with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade, subject to applicable UGC regulations.
* NET/SET/SLET qualification or a Ph.D.-based exemption, wherever applicable under prevailing UGC regulations and university recruitment policies.

**Experience Requirements**

* A minimum of
  **7 years of relevant professional experience**
  , which may comprise academic teaching but primarily industry experience.
* Experienced industry professionals seeking to transition into academia are encouraged to apply. The department values practical expertise, professional experience, teaching aptitude and the ability to bridge academic learning with evolving industry requirements.
* Candidates with substantial professional experience in digital media, digital marketing, marketing communication, advertising, public relations, brand communication, content strategy or allied domains will be considered.
* Candidates with experience in campaign planning, creative strategy, brand management, digital content production, audience engagement, marketing analytics or communication consultancy will have an added advantage.

**Key Areas of Competence**

* Digital media and multimedia content creation.
* Digital marketing, social media strategy and audience engagement.
* Advertising, marketing communication and integrated marketing communication.
* Brand communication, storytelling and content strategy.
* Digital campaign planning, execution and performance evaluation.
* Public relations and corporate communication.
* AI-enabled content creation, creative development and communication workflows.
* Digital analytics, SEO/SEM and emerging media technologies.

**Teaching and Academic Responsibilities**

* Teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses, as assigned, in digital media, marketing communication and allied areas.
* Design and deliver practical, project-based learning experiences informed by current industry practices.
* Guide students in developing portfolios, digital campaigns, multimedia projects and other professional media products.
* Integrate relevant AI tools and emerging technologies into teaching and learning.
* Contribute to curriculum development, assessment, academic documentation, research and departmental activities.
* Facilitate industry interactions, internships, workshops, live projects and professional networking opportunities.

**Preferred Profile**

* Candidates with a combination of academic teaching and professional industry experience.
* Industry practitioners with a demonstrable record of professional achievements who are passionate about teaching, mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Candidates with a portfolio of digital campaigns, branded content, advertising creatives, social media projects, multimedia productions or other relevant professional work.
* Experience in agency environments, media organizations, corporate communication teams, digital marketing firms or communication consultancies.
* Familiarity with generative or/and domain-based AI tools and their practical applications in digital media and marketing communication.

**Apply to : https://forms.gle/tMVh2wBqRJvcMYjw9**

title: Stage Social Media en Online Marketing
description:
**Ben jij een student in de richting van marketing, communicatie of commerciële economie en zoek je een stage waarbij je écht invloed hebt? Wil je niet meekijken vanaf de zijlijn, maar zelf onderzoeken, adviseren en verbeteren? Dan hebben wij een interessante stageopdracht voor jou.**
**Wie zijn wij?**
Vitesse Vorkheftrucks is dé specialist in verhuur en onderhoud van vorkheftrucks en zwaar materieel (1,5 tot 45 ton) in het Rotterdamse havengebied. In 2016 zijn we onderdeel geworden van Toyota Material Handling Nederland, maar we blijven opereren als zelfstandig en lokaal betrokken team. Onze kracht? Flexibiliteit, snelheid en service – met een eigen transportbedrijf om snel te kunnen schakelen voor klanten.
  
  
**De stageopdracht**
Vitesse is actief op social media, maar we zien kansen om onze online zichtbaarheid verder te vergroten.
  
  
**Tijdens Jouw Stage Onderzoek Je**

* Hoe we onze social media naar een hoger niveau kunnen tillen.
* Welke content het beste aansluit bij onze doelgroep.
* Welke social media-kanalen interessant zijn voor Vitesse.
* Welke online communities, platforms of netwerken kansen bieden om onze zichtbaarheid te vergroten.
* Hoe we meer bereik, interactie en naamsbekendheid kunnen creëren.

Je vertaalt jouw onderzoek naar een praktisch advies en helpt waar mogelijk ook mee met de uitvoering van jouw ideeën.
  
  
**Wat bieden wij?**

* Een uitdagende en zelfstandige stage met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
* Begeleiding door collega's uit verschillende afdelingen.
* Een organisatie waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk gehoord en gebruikt worden.
* Flexibiliteit in werkdagen en planning, waardoor de stage goed te combineren is met je studie.
* Een passende stagevergoeding.
* Een unieke kans om marketingervaring op te doen binnen een technische en commerciële organisatie.

**Wie zoeken wij?**
**Wij Zoeken Een Student Die**

* Een mbo- of hbo-opleiding volgt in de richting marketing, communicatie, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
* Nieuwsgierig, proactief en zelfstandig is.
* Interesse heeft in social media en online marketing.
* Graag onderzoek doet en met nieuwe ideeën komt.
* Niet bang is om collega's actief te benaderen voor informatie en inspiratie.

**Interesse?**
Lijkt het je leuk om de online zichtbaarheid van Vitesse Vorkheftrucks verder te ontwikkelen en jouw ideeën om te zetten in concrete adviezen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.
  
  
Je kunt hiervoor contact opnemen met Lilian de Haas via werving@vitessevorkheftrucks.nl. Liever eerst bellen? Bel dan naar 010-4293000.

title: SEO Paid Internship
description:
Location: Serampore, West Bengal, India

Job Type: Internship

Duration: 6 months

Monthly Stipend: ₹4,000

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM–3:00 PM

Openings: 1

Experience: Freshers welcome

Work Arrangement: On-site

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SEO Intern to join our growing digital marketing business in Serampore, West Bengal.

This paid internship is suitable for freshers who want practical experience in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, website optimization, keyword research, backlink building, and content planning.

You will work on real SEO projects, learn industry-relevant techniques, and gain practical exposure to improving organic search visibility and website performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Local SEO and Google Business Profile

* Assist with Google Business Profile optimization and local search visibility.
* Conduct local keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Research topics for business profile updates and local landing pages.
* Assist with business citations and directory listings.
* Monitor local rankings and profile performance.

2. Website SEO

* Assist with on-page optimization, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and internal linking.
* Conduct keyword research and identify relevant search opportunities.
* Help identify basic technical and on-page SEO issues.
* Support website content optimization and SEO audits.
* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console and other SEO tools.

3. Backlink Building and Off-Page SEO

* Research relevant websites for potential backlink opportunities.
* Assist with outreach, link building, and business listings.
* Analyze competitor backlink profiles.
* Maintain backlink records and review link quality.

4. Content Research and Planning

* Research blog topics and SEO content opportunities.
* Prepare content calendars based on keyword research.
* Identify competitor content gaps and search intent.
* Suggest topics for websites and Google Business Profile updates.

5. Reporting and Analysis

* Track keyword rankings and organic search performance.
* Assist with weekly and monthly SEO reports.
* Research search engine updates and SEO best practices.

Eligibility Criteria

* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* A basic understanding of SEO or digital marketing is an advantage.
* Interest in Local SEO, website optimization, and keyword research.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.
* Good research, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Willingness to learn, follow instructions, and complete assigned tasks responsibly.
* Ability to commute to our Serampore office for on-site work.

What You Will Learn

* Practical Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
* Keyword research and website SEO fundamentals.
* Backlink building and off-page SEO.
* Content strategy and competitor analysis.
* SEO reporting and performance tracking.
* Real-world SEO campaign execution.

About the Company

We are a newly established, founder-led digital marketing business that began operations in 2026. Our work focuses on SEO, local search visibility, Google Business Profile optimization, and website growth.

As a small and growing business, we offer the opportunity to learn directly through practical projects and gain exposure to different areas of SEO.

The internship includes a fixed monthly stipend of ₹4,000, a six-month duration, and Sunday off. Our goal is to provide a professional learning environment where motivated candidates can develop practical digital marketing skills.

title: Marketing Executive

title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Hiveloop E-Commerce Private Limited operates in the digital commerce sector, focusing on delivering value-driven products and services to a diverse customer base. The company leverages technology and data to streamline buying and selling processes and enhance customer experiences. Team members collaborate across functions to support growth, market expansion, and customer satisfaction. Hiveloop values adaptability, performance, and ethical business practices, offering opportunities to contribute to a fast-evolving marketplace.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales and Marketing Specialist role at Hiveloop E-Commerce Private Limited is a full-time, on-site position based in Barrackpur-II. The specialist is responsible for identifying potential customers, presenting products and services, and closing sales to meet revenue targets. Day-to-day tasks include managing customer inquiries, maintaining positive relationships, and providing service support before and after sales. The role involves assisting in basic marketing activities, gathering market feedback, and supporting promotional campaigns. The specialist may also participate in training sessions to improve product knowledge and sales techniques, while collaborating with team members and reporting performance to management.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to interact clearly and professionally with customers and colleagues.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle inquiries, resolve issues, and maintain positive client relationships.
* Candidates should possess Sales skills to identify opportunities, present offerings effectively, and achieve sales targets.
* Candidates should possess Training and Sales Management skills to support team development, follow sales processes, and contribute to performance improvements.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include basic knowledge of e-commerce operations, proficiency with common office and communication tools, ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and a results-oriented approach.
* A relevant diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in sales or customer-facing roles.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Edu World Skill Academy is an education and training organization focused on developing practical skills for learners across diverse disciplines. The academy aims to enhance employability by offering structured programs that align with industry needs and emerging career paths. It promotes an inclusive learning environment where participants can gain both theoretical knowledge and hands\-on experience. Team members at Edu World Skill Academy contribute directly to improving access to quality skill\-based education and supporting learner success.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Marketing Executive role based in North 24 Parganas. The Marketing Executive will support the promotion of the academy’s programs by planning and executing marketing campaigns, both offline and online. Day\-to\-day tasks include conducting market research to understand target audiences, assisting in market planning, coordinating with the sales team, and developing communication materials such as brochures, social media posts, and email content. The role involves engaging with prospective learners, educational partners, and local institutions to build brand awareness and drive admissions. The Marketing Executive will also track campaign performance, prepare reports, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging and effective outreach.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to perform market planning and market research, including analyzing trends and identifying target segments.
* Strong communication skills, with the capacity to create clear, engaging messaging for diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated experience or interest in sales and marketing activities, particularly within the education or training sector.
* Comfort using basic digital tools for marketing and data tracking (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation tools, social media platforms).
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Capacity to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and interact professionally with learners and partners.
* Local language proficiency and familiarity with the North 24 Parganas region will be an advantage.
